phase_rule: For every valid historical row, phi_new=atan2(saved_sin,saved_cos)+2*pi*saved_frequency*(state_measurement_us-encoder_source_timestamp_us)*1e-6. Only sin/cos change. Last corrected phase initializes the unchanged future extrapolator.
phase_admission: Conditional software-source-time assumption; NOT verified physical measurement alignment. Frequency is the already-available low-pass estimate; no future phase or frequency is used.
V1_physical_alignment: not_admitted: internal AS5600 sampling/filter latency and exact I2C timing unavailable
V2: not_admitted unless audit proves causal bracketing for all frozen histories without extrapolation; no extrapolation model will be fitted
distribution_reference: Train main_50hz valid_history_state & valid_encoder & valid_frequency; original per-flight data; exact KD nearest distances excluding receiver flight; standardized by training-only scale, phase sin/cos scale=1. Coarse joint support only.
